posts.title: The value of a threshold
posts.excerpt: The spaces between rooms shape how a home feels as much as the rooms themselves.
posts.content: A threshold is a pause. It is the moment a garden becomes a room, or a busy street gives way to a quiet interior.

posts.title: Material notes: oak
posts.excerpt: On a material that brings warmth, tactility, and a quiet sense of permanence.
posts.content: Oak is familiar without being ordinary. Its grain records how a tree grew, and its tone changes gently with light.

posts.title: Designing with daylight
posts.excerpt: A few observations on shaping rooms around the changing light of a day.
posts.content: Good daylight is not simply a matter of adding glass. Orientation, depth, reflectance, and shade all play a part.
